event.wren_heart4.setup.text: Up, up, no sitting yet. Tonight I'm trying something, and I need a witness. Possibly an accomplice. Definitely a crowd.
event.wren_heart4.setup.why: three scenes opened with 'Don't'; the doubled word is her shipped tic, and 'Stay' is reserved for the bag reply

event.reading_night.3.text: Ignore me, I'm off duty. I came to hear one story I'm not allowed to improve. It's harder than it sounds.
event.reading_night.3.why: second 'Don't' opener gone; story_cat keeps the only one

event.wren_friend.intro.text: Friday means bingo. Not numbers, rumors. Take a card, cross off anything you've heard twice.
event.wren_friend.intro.why: five intros commanded 'sit'; thinned to three so the tic stays a signature

event.wren_birthday.intro.text: My birthday! You knew, because I lit a very small flare. Be festive. Have a pickle from the good jar.
event.wren_birthday.intro.why: drops another 'sit' and avoids a new 'It's' opener collision with heart5

event.hall_dance.12.text: Marcus takes his one dance, and Tilda, two steps away, takes her own. The lamps burn low, and nobody goes home.
event.hall_dance.12.why: staging rule: no two people dancing together; 'beside him' read as a couple
